new.title: Have vegan cake at the cafe DIE Schwestern in Gostenhof
new.desc: A vegetarian cafe on Kernstrasse in the Gostenhof district, known for housemade vegan and vegetarian cakes. Gostenhof is the city's creative, multicultural quarter west of the old town.
new.tip: Come for coffee and cake in the afternoon. Take the U1 to Bärenschanze or Gostenhof.

new.title: Drink freshly roasted coffee at Rösttrommel
new.desc: Rösttrommel is a Nuremberg coffee roastery with cafes, including one on Fürther Strasse near the Bärenschanze area. Beans are roasted in the city.
new.tip: Try a filter coffee or espresso and take a bag of beans home.

new.title: Linger at the Atelier Ladencafé in St. Johannis
new.desc: A neighbourhood cafe on Hallerstrasse in St. Johannis, the leafy district north of the old town with Dürer's grave and the Hesperidengärten nearby.
new.tip: Combine it with a walk to the Johannisfriedhof. Best for weekend breakfast or afternoon coffee.
new.q: Atelier Ladencafé, Hallerstraße 31, St. Johannis, Nürnberg

new.title: Eat plant-based Vietnamese at Katzentempel
new.desc: A Vietnamese restaurant on Peter-Vischer-Strasse whose menu is built around plant-based meat substitutes; HappyCow lists it as fully vegan since September 2022.
new.tip: Check opening hours before you go. Moderate prices.

new.title: Roll a vegan çiğ köfte wrap at Cigköftem Plärrer
new.desc: A Turkish fast-food spot near the Plärrer specialising in çiğ köfte, with a vegan version rated highly by vegan travellers.
new.tip: Quick and cheap; handy before a train from the Plärrer.

new.title: Pair craft beer with sauerkraut at the Orca.Bar
new.desc: A bright, modern bar on Engelhardsgasse that pairs craft beer with Franconian-style sauerkraut dishes, close to Jakobsplatz.
new.tip: Ask for the current taps; evenings are busiest.

new.title: Have coffee in the Kaffeebohne on Gustavstraße
new.desc: A long-standing cafe by day and bar by night on Fürth's Gustavstrasse, with outdoor seating on the street. Reviewers praise the baguettes and salads.
new.tip: Sit outside in summer. The street is Fürth's main pub and restaurant strip.

new.title: Order Schweinebraten at the Grüner Baum in Fürth
new.desc: A traditional restaurant at Gustavstrasse 34, where guests highlight the roast pork and large portions.
new.tip: Ask for the roast pork with dumplings.

new.title: Eat vegan dishes at Die Bar on Gustavstraße
new.desc: A bar-restaurant at Gustavstrasse 33 with many vegan dishes, open daily from 10:00 until 1:00 according to listings.
new.tip: Kitchen hours can be limited in the afternoon.

new.title: Eat organic at Muskat on Erlangen's Hauptstraße
new.desc: An organic restaurant with cafe and catering on Hauptstrasse in the Erlangen old town.

new.title: Eat Aischgrund carp at Gasthaus Dürrbeck
new.desc: Gasthaus Dürrbeck in Jungenhofen near Höchstadt placed in the top three of a regional reader poll for carp quality. Aischgründer Karpfen is an EU protected designation.
new.tip: Carp season runs September to April; choose blue or baked carp.
new.q: Gasthaus Dürrbeck, Jungenhofen 6, Höchstadt an der Aisch

new.title: Order baked carp at Gasthaus Zur Sonne in Lonnerstadt
new.desc: The inn serves original Aischgründer carp from local ponds daily during its season, September to April.

new.title: Taste Pyraser beer at the Landbrauerei in Pyras
new.desc: The Pyraser Landbrauerei is a country brewery in Pyras near Thalmässing in Landkreis Roth, listed in the district's tourism brochure.
new.tip: Check the tavern opening hours before travelling.

new.title: Drink house-brewed beer at Gasthaus Lohgarten in Roth
new.desc: A Roth inn with its own brewery and a beer garden, listed among the district's brewery inns.
new.tip: The beer garden is best on summer evenings.

new.title: Sample a hundred beers at the Bierwerk
new.desc: A bar at Unschlittplatz by the Pegnitz offering about 100 beers from around the world plus its own craft beers.
new.tip: Go in the evening; ask staff for local picks.

new.title: Drink wheat beer at the Weissbierhex
new.desc: A bar in the old town at Jakobstrasse 17 dedicated to wheat beer.

new.title: Walk GoHo's street art and backyards
new.desc: Gostenhof and Muggenhof (GoHo) is Nuremberg's alternative quarter, with street art and graffiti on walls, transformer houses and underpasses, and a city tourism self-guided walk.
new.tip: Take the U1 from Lorenzkirche. Download the GoHo walk PDF from the tourism office.

new.title: Stroll the Botanical Garden next to the Erlangen Schlossgarten
new.desc: The University of Erlangen-Nuremberg's botanical garden has outdoor grounds and greenhouses; entry is free.
new.tip: Greenhouses Tuesday to Sunday; outdoor grounds daily. Hours vary by season.
